$comment: One row per file under .github/workflows: its group (pr-gates, main-push, daily, weekly, release, maintenance), what it verifies in one sentence, and whether its check is required by the branch protection of main. Triggers and schedules are read from the files. go run ./test/ciworkflows writes docs/ci-workflows.md; -check fails when a workflow has no row, a row names no workflow, a row breaks its group or the page is stale.

auto-release.yaml.verifies: On every push to main: decides from the changelog whether a release is due, validates, tags, builds, signs and publishes it, and refreshes the release metadata pull request.

cancel-conflicted-pr-runs.yaml.verifies: After a push to main, cancels the pull request runs of open pull requests that now conflict with main.

change-scope.yaml.verifies: Reusable: reports which lanes of jobs a pull request needs (product, stack, baseline) from its changed files.

changelog-pr.yaml.verifies: A pull request that changes shipped code carries a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased.

ci.yaml.verifies: Unit tests, race, fuzz smoke, lint, conformance gate, image, compose stacks (e2e-compat, fleet, UI), helm and docker checks.

codeql.yaml.verifies: CodeQL analysis of the Go code and the workflows, also weekly on main.

compat-drilldown.yaml.verifies: Logs Drilldown compatibility against the pinned and matrix Grafana and plugin versions.

compat-loki.yaml.verifies: Loki API compatibility against the pinned Loki and the Loki version matrix.

compat-vl.yaml.verifies: Compatibility with the pinned VictoriaLogs and the supported VictoriaLogs version matrix.

docs-site.yaml.verifies: Builds the documentation site on pull requests that touch it and deploys it from main.

e2e-pipeline.yml.verifies: The end-to-end ingest pipeline stack answers through the proxy.

error-answers-record.yaml.verifies: Asks the pinned Loki the recorded error requests again and fails when an answer changed.

ghcr-badges.yaml.verifies: Refreshes the container pull count badges.

parity-refresh.yaml.verifies: Differential run of the proxy against Loki over the whole corpus on a fresh stack; opens the rolling parity report pull request.

perf-ab.yaml.verifies: Per pull request A/B smoke of the base build, the PR build and Loki over the shapes the change selects.

perf-daily.yaml.verifies: Full A/B run of the last release, main and Loki over every shape set and range; opens the rolling performance report pull request.

pr-evidence-summary.yaml.verifies: Summarises the evidence artifacts of a pull request's finished runs; runs no pull request code.

pr-labeler.yaml.verifies: Labels pull requests from their changed paths.

pr-quality-report.yaml.verifies: Base against head quality report: coverage floor, tests, query corpus, compatibility scores and tracked performance.

query-corpus.yaml.verifies: Builds the query corpus of main and re-verifies the recorded Loki and VictoriaLogs answers, differentials and the grammar sweep with the live oracles.

release-pr-validation.yaml.verifies: The bot's release metadata and report pull requests carry only the files the bot may write.

release.yaml.verifies: Manual republish of a release tag: binaries, SBOMs, provenance, signatures, images (GHCR and Docker Hub), Helm chart and release assets.

scorecard.yaml.verifies: Publishes the OpenSSF Scorecard result of main.

security-heavy.yaml.verifies: Image and SBOM scan, semgrep, long fuzzing and the DAST scan of a running proxy.

security-pr.yaml.verifies: Static security checks and the runtime security smoke of the pull request build.

visual-smoke-cleanup.yaml.verifies: Removes the visual proof montages of closed pull requests.

visual-smoke.yaml.verifies: Grafana Explore and Logs Drilldown screenshots of the base build, the PR build and Loki for the pages the change touches.
